Game Overview

Xmas Furious is a arcade game built around guide Santa's sleigh through a balloon-infested North Pole in Xmas Furious. Navigate challenging levels, avoiding obstacles while collecting presents. Enjoy a festive atmosphere with a delightful Christmas soundtrack, making each carefully timed move a holiday thrill. Embrace the season's cheer and ensure every gift reaches its destination!
